analysis: Post-hoc descriptive analysis of existing full-name base-order trajectories; no new inference
threshold_definition: At least one of 49 disease scores changes by at least threshold in absolute value between consecutive rounds. Thresholds selected for this descriptive analysis, not preregistered.
scope: Normalized complete-disease-name sequence scores, not calibrated disease probabilities or layerwise internal probabilities. 24 complete trajectories, not all 120 cases.
